title: Notification prompt and local notifications
summary: Asks for notification permission once (first launch) and schedules the offline lives / event reminders.
description: NotificationPrompt asks over Loading on the first launch (game.json `notifications.*`) and schedules local notifications (lives full, the weekly contest ending) from GameCore's EventNotifications planner. No server: everything is local.

strings: The Weekly Cup ends in 2 hours!
Your lives are full! Time to play!
